panels.description: Number of times Flight RPC call has failed unexpectedly.
panels.title: Flight RPC Errors

panels.description:
Number of failed DoPut requests for durable storage classes that failed because the server was not able to even start writing the durable data.

This indicates durable storage mis-configuration.
panels.title: DoPut durable errors

panels.description: Number of DoPut requests that were rejected because the server is applying backpressure.
panels.title: DoPut backpressure

panels.description:
Number of DoPut requests that were rejected because the server was in read-only mode.

This can happen when the server loses connection to the etcd cluster.
panels.title: DoPut readonly rejects

panels.description:
Number of DoPut failures that occurred due to server's cache resources being exhausted. For non-durable flights, the requests cannot even fallback to durable storage and are outright cancelled.

This can happen when the server's cache resources are under high pressure and the server was unable to reclaim storage for the non-durable flight.
panels.title: DoPut storage exhausted

panels.description: Number of timeouts encountered while waiting for local views to sync to particular store revision.
panels.title: Sync timeouts

panels.description: Number of DoGet requests rejected due to server backpressure.
panels.title: DoGet backpressure

panels.description: Number of DoGet requests which the server had to serve from durable storage but failed. Serving from durable storage is a fallback when the server cannot load data into the caches due to high pressure on the cache resources.
panels.title: DoGet from durable errors

panels.description: Number of DoGet requests that were served directly from durable storage. This usually happens if server's cache is under huge pressure and it fails to load data to load data into caches because they are all at their limit and heavily used by competing requests.
panels.title: DoGet from durable

panels.description:
Shows how many requests are running and how many are waiting.

NOTE: this may be empty / half empty if the new throttling policy is not turned on the server.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, limit) (quiver_rpc_limits{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod="${nodes.0}", rq_method="SHARD_DO_PUT"})

panels.title: Overview - v2 metrics

panels.description: Time it took to transfer the data to DoPut.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(quiver_data_xfer_duration_sum{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod=~"${nodes}"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(quiver_data_xfer_duration_count{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod=~"${nodes}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Data Transfer Duration

panels.description: Number of open write streams to durable storage.
panels.title: Durable Writes in Progress

panels.description: Time spent waiting until the DoPut request starts executing. DoPut has limited concurrency and may be throttled and the requests will be queued.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(quiver_rpc_wait_sum{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod=~"${nodes}", action_type="DO_PUT"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(quiver_rpc_wait_count{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod=~"${nodes}", action_type="DO_PUT"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Wait Time

panels.description: DoPut requests per second per shard
panels.title: DoPut handled req/s

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(quiver_rpc_duration_sum{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod=~"${nodes}", method="DO_PUT"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(quiver_rpc_duration_count{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod=~"${nodes}", method="DO_PUT"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: DoGet requests per second per shard
panels.title: DoGet handled req/s

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(quiver_rpc_duration_sum{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod=~"${nodes}", method="DO_GET"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(quiver_rpc_duration_count{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod=~"${nodes}", method="DO_GET"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Rate of restores from durable storage
panels.title: Restore per second

panels.description: Durations of restores from durable storage.

targets.expr: sum by (pod) (rate(quiver_get_restore_durable_sum{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod=~"${nodes}"}[$__rate_interval]) / rate(quiver_get_restore_durable_count{cluster_name="${cluster}", namespace="${ns}", pod=~"${nodes}"}[$__rate_interval]))

title: GoodData CN - Quiver Shards Overview
description:
Per-shard view of the Quiver cache/Flight layer (FlightRPC DoPut/DoGet, cache + durable storage usage, backpressure and store-sync health). Use the Cluster / Namespace / Nodes variables to scope to specific shard pods.

Translated from the internal grafana-dashboards repo (panther/pnt-quiver-shard-overview.json).
